title: Shut Up and Let Me Play - An Actual Skip Button
summary: Fast-forward is not skip. Restores native hold-to-skip for supported Crimson Desert gameplay cutscenes and NPC dialogue. No custom overlay, auto-skip, or remapping. Requires a compatible x64 ASI loader.
